text: Yes, the property lost tree cover in 2019. Earth-observation data shows a 1.8-hectare loss of planted pine forest (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*). The event meets the corroboration rule: it was observed in the Hansen dataset (2019) and confirmed by the JRC 2020 reference, which mapped the area as forest. Although smaller patches (3.1 hectares) of loss were detected below the 0.5-hectare threshold and excluded from the main event, the primary loss of 1.8 hectares is valid and occurred in 2019.
